revisionConfirmationCapabilities.revision: No revision, ETag, If-Match or client idempotency field consumed. post/settle/credit/refund require boolean confirm=true; false parses then refuses. Invoice issue/preview and customer create have no confirmation input. Unknown JSON fields rejected.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.controls: Continuously admitted owner/company namespace, current control transaction authority and company immediate transaction. Business writes require active workspace transfer and backup write fence; compiled posting policy current, validated journal periods/closed-period controls remain. Preview readonly; no invoice number reserved. Issue reserves consecutive fiscal-scope number, publishes immutable JSON then PDF and registers evidence in transaction; publication can survive failed transaction. Post verifies original JSON/PDF and credits; refuses any existing journal, not replay-success. Settle/refund require active original posting and frozen receivable, never current debtors-role replacement; same-currency imported bank evidence and distinct mapped active bank account. Credit proportional original-account/allocation proof and canonical/legacy source checks; closed periods and latest-date policy still apply. PDF read access audit may itself fail after reading; HEAD is not an effect-free probe.

retry.naturalDedup: No keyed native receipt, scope, expiry or tombstone. Original invoice journal existence refuses duplicate posting; imported bank reconciliation blocks receipt/refund reuse, not replay-success. Customer uniqueness may refuse duplicates; partial credits can be valid multiple times and are NOT deduplicated. Invoice number next-sequence check is allocation control, not idempotency.
retry.readBack: Read GET /api/companies/{slug}/invoices with appropriate fiscal year, correlate documentId/invoiceNo and original document JSON/PDF SHA256, issued_invoice_postings and journal entry identity; use existing original invoice detail/status/payment/credit/refund readbacks under current authority and source, imported bank transaction ID/reference and bank_journal_reconciliations for cash movements. Customer: contacts.customers.id/name. Absence is not proof if year, source, archival or access changed. Reconcile exact invoice/journal/evidence, not just aggregate balance, before any explicit further write. Unknown non-key write: never automatically post/send/reissue/replay as new; reused receipt is not new authorization or a new invoice. A changed read scope or missing row is not rollback proof.
retry.unresolvedProvider: No external mail/payment/provider dispatch in these operations; cash movement consumes already imported evidence. Existing public e-invoice status is a read projection only: uncertain/legacy handoff is not permission to resend. Published evidence and transaction outcome can differ after interruption; reconcile exact authoritative records.
